render: Compose Canvas and Compose animation; no Lottie/Rive dependency and no raster frame sequences required.

accessibility.reduceMotion: Static scene and static portal; no particles, pulsing or rotating decoration.
accessibility.manualSetting: If automatic system animation scale is not reliably available in the current stack, add a stored Reduce effects option.
accessibility.lifecycle: Run decorative animations only when screen is visible and lifecycle RESUMED.

portal.disconnected: Static dim world ring, start action from existing contract.
portal.connecting: Slow indeterminate arc only if real Connecting is exposed by current state source. Otherwise omit this state.
portal.connected: Solid world ring; optional restrained 4000 ms pulse, static under reduced motion.
portal.requestPending: A brief presentation response to touch is not proof of VPN connecting/connected.
portal.stateOwnership: No animation callback starts/stops VPN or sets isRunning.

original.type: two static bezier highlights or none; source scene already has ribbons

aurora.type: one soft gradient overlay near outer sky
